instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 100% client-side mobile-first PWA file converter tailored for vertical screens (max-w-md on desktop).
UI language MUST be Italian: 'ConvertiTutto', 'Seleziona File', 'Formato Destinazione', 'Converti Ora', 'Salva nel telefono', 'Unisci in PDF multipagina A4', '100% Locale & Privato'.
Utilize FFmpeg.wasm multi-thread / single-thread fallback for Audio/Video conversion with Web Workers so UI stays butter-smooth.
Utilize Canvas API + jsPDF for Image/PDF conversions (supports JPG, PNG, WEBP and combining multiple images into a clean A4 multi-page PDF document).
Use Shadcn Sheet component for the Format Picker bottom sheet (side='bottom') with tactile pill selectors.
Provide big touch targets ('pulsantoni') with distinct tactile press animations and high contrast dark theme (#0B0F17 base, #131B2A panel, #2563EB accent).
Ensure complete offline functionality: no backend upload calls, all conversions happen in browser memory using Blobs and Object URLs.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='select-file-btn', data-testid='format-sheet-trigger', data-testid='convert-now-btn', data-testid='save-to-phone-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Use high-contrast tactical dark styling with subtle 1px slate-800 borders and vibrant cobalt/cyan accents. Avoid generic gray gradients.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Ample mobile tap padding (p-4 to p-6) with safe-area spacing for bottom navigation bars.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interaction: Micro-haptic visual feedback via motion/react active states and instant Sonner toast alerts on complete/error.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.fonts: Space Grotesk for bold tactical headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for high-legibility body/data.
